recipes.title: Savory Toasted Sesame Oil Oats with Soft Egg & Scallions
recipes.summary: Cozy broth-simmered rolled oats crowned with a soft egg, sliced scallions, soy sauce, and a fragrant swirl of toasted sesame oil.
steps: Simmer rolled oats in vegetable broth 6 to 7 minutes until creamy, then stir in baby spinach until wilted.
Spoon into a warm bowl and nestle a soft-cooked egg right on top.
Finish with soy sauce, sliced scallions, and a fragrant drizzle of toasted sesame oil.
tips: A little toasted sesame oil goes a long way—drizzling it right before eating keeps its roasted aroma vivid.
Warm, soft, and easy to spoon on crisp mornings.

recipes.title: Silky Korean-Style Steamed Egg Custard with Sesame Oil
recipes.summary: Cloud-soft savory egg custard gently steamed with warm broth and finished with scallions and aromatic toasted sesame oil.

ingredient_details.item: warm low-sodium chicken or vegetable broth

steps: Whisk eggs gently with warm broth and half the scallions in a heatproof bowl.
Place the bowl in a saucepan with 1 inch of gently simmering water, cover, and steam 8 to 9 minutes until jiggly and silky.
Carefully lift out and drizzle with toasted sesame oil, remaining scallions, and sesame seeds.
tips: Steamed egg (gyeranjjim) is one of the softest, easiest-to-swallow high-protein breakfasts in the world.
Keep the simmering water gentle so the custard stays velvety smooth.

recipes.title: Toasted Sesame Oil, Avocado & Ginger Whole-Grain Toast
recipes.summary: Crisp whole-grain toast topped with creamy mashed avocado, a few drops of soy sauce, grated ginger, and nutty toasted sesame oil.
steps: Mash avocado with soy sauce and finely grated ginger using a fork.
Spread evenly across warm whole-grain toast.
Drizzle toasted sesame oil over the avocado and sprinkle with scallions.
tips: Toasted sesame oil and avocado create an instant umami-rich breakfast with zero stovetop work.
Add sliced cucumber on top for fresh crunch.

recipes.title: Warm Chicken-Broth Rice Congee with Toasted Sesame Oil
recipes.summary: Classic comforting rice porridge simmered with shredded ginger and finished generously with nutty toasted sesame oil and scallions.

ingredient_details.item: pinch of white or black pepper

steps: Simmer cooked rice, broth, and grated ginger in a saucepan 15 minutes, stirring often until thick and velvety.
Ladle into warm bowls and season lightly with white pepper.
Swirl 1 tsp toasted sesame oil onto each bowl and top with sliced scallions.
tips: Stir in shredded poached chicken or a soft egg if you want extra staying power.
A soothing, warm breakfast that is gentle on the stomach.

recipes.title: Toasted Sesame Oil, Banana & Maple Warm Oatmeal
recipes.summary: Creamy rolled oats sweetened with ripe banana and pure maple syrup, given warm roasted-halva depth from a delicate drizzle of toasted sesame oil.
steps: Simmer rolled oats, milk, and cinnamon 6 to 7 minutes until tender and creamy.
Spoon into a warm bowl and layer with sliced ripe banana.
Drizzle pure maple syrup and 1 tsp toasted sesame oil over the warm oats to serve.
tips: Toasted sesame oil and maple syrup taste surprisingly like roasted peanut butter or Middle Eastern halva—completely tree-nut-free.
Start with 1 teaspoon so the toasted sesame stays warm and balanced.

recipes.title: Chilled Toasted Sesame Oil Soba Noodles with Cucumber
recipes.summary: Nutty buckwheat soba noodles tossed with crisp cucumber ribbons, shelled edamame, rice vinegar, soy sauce, and fragrant toasted sesame oil.
steps: Boil soba noodles 5 to 6 minutes until tender, then rinse thoroughly under cold water and drain.
Whisk toasted sesame oil, soy sauce, and rice vinegar in a large bowl.
Toss chilled noodles, cucumber, edamame, and scallions in the dressing until glossy and serve cool.
tips: Rinsing soba under cold water removes excess starch so the noodles stay light and never clump.
Snip cooked noodles lightly with kitchen shears for effortless fork bites.

recipes.title: Crisp Smashed Cucumber, Chickpea & Sesame Oil Salad
recipes.summary: Refreshing Chinese-inspired cucumber salad paired with tender chickpeas, garlic, rice vinegar, and deeply aromatic toasted sesame oil.
steps: Whisk toasted sesame oil, rice vinegar, soy sauce, and grated garlic in a bowl.
Add sliced cucumber and rinsed chickpeas and toss gently to coat.
Rest 5 minutes so the cucumbers drink up the dressing, then fold in cilantro and serve crisp.
tips: English or Persian cucumbers have thin tender skins and tiny seeds so no peeling is required.
Add shredded poached chicken to turn this into a heartier protein bowl.

recipes.title: 10-Minute Silken Tofu, Spinach & Sesame Oil Miso Soup
recipes.summary: Soothing savory miso broth brimming with soft silken tofu cubes, baby spinach, ginger, and a warming finish of toasted sesame oil.
steps: Bring water and grated ginger to a gentle simmer in a saucepan, then turn heat to very low.
Stir miso paste into 1/4 cup warm broth in a small bowl until smooth, then pour back into the pot with tofu cubes and baby spinach.
Warm 2 minutes without boiling, ladle into bowls, and finish with toasted sesame oil and scallions.
tips: Never boil miso paste—keeping it gently warm preserves its delicate probiotics and aroma.
Soft silken tofu and warm broth make a wonderfully gentle lunch.

recipes.title: Korean-Inspired Sesame Oil Spinach, Carrot & Egg Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Gentle bibimbap-style lunch bowl pairing steamed spinach and carrots dressed in garlic and toasted sesame oil over warm rice with a soft egg.

ingredient_details.item: warm cooked brown or white rice

steps: Steam-saute baby spinach and shredded carrots with 2 tbsp water in a skillet for 3 minutes until soft; drain excess water.
Toss warm vegetables with minced garlic, soy sauce, and 1 tbsp toasted sesame oil.
Pile over bowls of warm rice, crown with soft eggs, and finish with the remaining 1/2 tbsp toasted sesame oil.
tips: Classic Korean sigeumchi-namul (sesame-garlicky spinach) turns a whole bag of greens tender and savory in 3 minutes.
Skip spicy chili paste for a mild, comforting everyday bowl.

recipes.title: Shredded Poached Chicken & Napa Cabbage Sesame Oil Salad
recipes.summary: Tender shredded chicken, finely sliced mild Napa cabbage, mandarin orange segments, and ginger tossed in toasted sesame oil vinaigrette.
steps: Shake toasted sesame oil, rice vinegar, grated ginger, and 1 tbsp water in a jar until blended.
Toss shredded Napa cabbage, cooked chicken, and scallions gently with the dressing.
Fold in juicy orange segments right before serving.
tips: Napa cabbage is noticeably softer and gentler to chew than dense green cabbage.
Add toasted sliced almonds if you enjoy extra crunch.

recipes.title: Cantonese-Style Steamed Salmon with Ginger & Toasted Sesame Oil
recipes.summary: Melt-in-your-mouth steamed salmon fillets finished in classic Cantonese fashion with soy sauce, ginger, scallions, and aromatic toasted sesame oil.
steps: Arrange salmon fillets and baby bok choy in a steamer basket or plate over simmering water, topped with shredded ginger.
Cover and steam gently 8 to 10 minutes until salmon flakes effortlessly and greens are tender.
Drizzle soy sauce and toasted sesame oil over the hot fish and greens and scatter with sliced scallions.
tips: Steaming gives salmon a silky custard-like tenderness with zero frying splatter.
Serve over warm jasmine rice to soak up the fragrant sesame-soy juices.

recipes.title: Honey-Soy & Toasted Sesame Oil Skillet Chicken with Green Beans
recipes.summary: Tender skillet chicken pieces and crisp-tender green beans tossed off the heat with garlic, light soy-honey glaze, and fragrant toasted sesame oil.
steps: Saute chicken pieces in neutral oil over medium-high heat 6 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Add green beans and 3 tbsp water, cover, and steam-cook 4 minutes until bright green and tender.
Stir in garlic, soy sauce, and honey for 1 minute, turn off heat, and toss thoroughly with toasted sesame oil.
tips: Finishing with cold-pressed toasted sesame oil off the burner preserves its deep nutty perfume.
Cut green beans into bite-sized pieces so they're easy to scoop with rice.

recipes.title: Garlicky Mushroom, Broccoli & Soft Tofu Sesame Oil Braise
recipes.summary: Comforting homestyle Chinese vegetable and tofu braise in light savory broth finished with fragrant cold-pressed toasted sesame oil.
steps: Simmer mushrooms, broccoli florets, garlic, soy sauce, and vegetable broth in a covered skillet for 6 minutes until broccoli is tender.
Gently slide in cubed tofu and simmer uncovered 4 minutes so it absorbs the savory broth.
Remove from heat and drizzle generously with toasted sesame oil before spooning over warm rice.
tips: Braising tofu instead of pan-frying keeps every bite ultra-soft and cuts out oily splatter.
Stir 1 tsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tsp cold water in at the end if you like a glossier sauce.

recipes.title: Toasted Sesame Oil & Ginger Glazed Sweet Potatoes with Edamame
recipes.summary: Tender oven-roasted sweet potato wedges tossed warm with shelled edamame, ginger, lime juice, and aromatic toasted sesame oil.
steps: Heat oven to 400 F; toss sweet potato cubes with neutral oil and roast 20 minutes until golden and fork-tender.
Whisk toasted sesame oil, grated ginger, and fresh lime juice in a warm bowl.
Toss hot roasted sweet potatoes, warm edamame, and sliced scallions with the sesame-ginger dressing and serve.
tips: Caramelized sweet potato and toasted sesame oil are an irresistible sweet-nutty match.
Serve over a handful of baby spinach or brown rice.

recipes.title: Savory Ground Turkey, Cabbage & Sesame Oil Noodle Skillet
recipes.summary: Fast one-skillet supper of lean ground turkey, soft shredded cabbage, carrots, and noodles finished with soy sauce and toasted sesame oil.
steps: Brown ground turkey in a lightly oiled skillet 6 minutes, breaking into fine tender crumbles.
Add shredded cabbage, carrots, garlic, and 3 tbsp water; cook 5 minutes until vegetables soften completely.
Fold in cooked rice noodles and soy sauce, turn off heat, and drizzle toasted sesame oil throughout.
tips: Bagged coleslaw mix skips all vegetable shredding on busy evenings.
Fine turkey crumbles and soft cabbage make chewing effortless.

recipes.title: Toasted Sesame Oil, Banana & Date Halva Smoothie
recipes.summary: Velvety Middle Eastern-inspired smoothie pairing frozen banana, Medjool date, oat milk, cinnamon, and a fragrant teaspoon of toasted sesame oil.
steps: Place oat milk, frozen banana, pitted date, cinnamon, vanilla, and toasted sesame oil in a blender.
Blend 50 seconds until thick, creamy, and lightly caramelized in flavor.
Pour into a glass and enjoy chilled.
tips: Tastes remarkably like sweet sesame halva or toasted peanut butter without any tree nuts.
Keep to 1 to 1 1/2 teaspoons of toasted sesame oil so its roasted flavor stays smooth and cozy.

recipes.title: Toasted Sesame Oil, Cocoa & Rolled Oats Shake
recipes.summary: Rich bakery-style chocolate-sesame smoothie blending cocoa powder, rolled oats, milk, banana, and a nutty whisper of toasted sesame oil.
steps: Add milk, rolled oats, frozen banana, cocoa powder, maple syrup, and toasted sesame oil to a blender.
Blend on high 55 seconds until silky and chocolatey.
Serve immediately in a chilled glass.
tips: Chocolate and toasted sesame is a classic pastry-chef pairing—deeply nutty yet completely nut-free.
Use soy milk for extra plant protein.

recipes.title: Asian Mango, Ginger & Sesame Oil Tropical Smoothie
recipes.summary: Vibrant golden mango and yogurt smoothie brightened with ginger and lime, rounded with a delicate nutty teaspoon of toasted sesame oil.
steps: Combine oat milk, Greek yogurt, frozen mango, grated ginger, lime juice, and toasted sesame oil in a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until lush golden and completely smooth.
Pour into a glass and enjoy cold.
tips: Toasted sesame oil echoes mango sticky-rice desserts in a refreshing sippable glass.
A single teaspoon brings warm roasted depth without overpowering the bright fruit.

recipes.title: Blueberry, Honey & Toasted Sesame Oil Yogurt Smoothie
recipes.summary: Mediterranean-meets-Asian berry smoothie pairing frozen blueberries, plain Greek yogurt, milk, honey, and subtle toasted sesame oil.
steps: Place milk, Greek yogurt, frozen blueberries, honey, cardamom, and toasted sesame oil in a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until rich purple and velvety.
Serve cold right away.
tips: Honey, cardamom, and toasted sesame taste like a fragrant bakery pastry in liquid form.
Swap cardamom for cinnamon if preferred.

recipes.title: Creamy Roasted Sweet Potato & Toasted Sesame Oil Smoothie
recipes.summary: Inspired by Korean sweet potato lattes: soft cooked sweet potato blended creamy with oat milk, banana, cinnamon, and toasted sesame oil.
steps: Combine oat milk, cooked sweet potato, frozen banana, cinnamon, maple syrup, and toasted sesame oil in a blender.
Blend 50 seconds until luxuriously thick and smooth.
Enjoy chilled—or warm gently for a cozy evening latte.
tips: Korean goguma (sweet potato) and toasted sesame are an iconic comfort flavor pairing.
A smart way to use leftover baked sweet potato.

recipes.title: Crisp Cucumber, Ginger & Toasted Sesame Oil Spa Tonic
recipes.summary: Ultra-clean East Asian spa press shaking fresh cucumber juice, lime, ginger, and a delicate fragrant drop of toasted sesame oil.
steps: Combine fresh cucumber juice, chilled water, lime juice, ginger juice, and 1/2 tsp toasted sesame oil in a jar.
Shake briskly 10 seconds to create a delicate aromatic mist through the juice.
Pour over ice and sip refreshing and cold.
tips: With bold toasted sesame oil, half a teaspoon in juice perfumes the whole glass cleanly without heaviness.
Echoes the refreshing crunch of chilled sesame cucumber salad.

recipes.title: Golden Carrot, Mandarin & Sesame Oil Ginger Press
recipes.summary: Sweet pressed carrot and orange juice shaken briskly with zesty ginger and a fragrant half-teaspoon of cold-pressed toasted sesame oil.

ingredient_details.item: freshly squeezed orange or mandarin juice

steps: Add carrot juice, orange juice, ginger juice, lime juice, and toasted sesame oil to a lidded jar.
Shake vigorously 10 seconds to emulsify finely.
Pour over ice and serve immediately.
tips: Sweet mandarin, ginger, and toasted sesame oil is a beloved flavor trio—and helps absorb carrot carotenoids.
Use untoasted cold-pressed sesame oil if you prefer an even milder finish.

recipes.title: Savory Umami Tomato, Celery & Toasted Sesame Oil Tonic
recipes.summary: Crisp chilled tomato and celery juice seasoned with rice vinegar, a drop of soy sauce, and nutty toasted sesame oil.
steps: Pour tomato juice, celery juice, rice vinegar, soy sauce, and toasted sesame oil into a jar.
Shake briskly 10 seconds until smooth and unified.
Serve cold over ice cubes.
tips: A crisp, savory afternoon refresher with zero added sugar and great lycopene absorption.
Garnish with a fresh celery stalk or cucumber ribbon.

recipes.title: Korean Asian Pear, Ginger & Toasted Sesame Oil Press
recipes.summary: Crisp, delicate pear juice shaken with a warm spark of fresh ginger, lemon, and a gentle aromatic whisper of toasted sesame oil.
steps: Combine pure pear juice, chilled water, ginger juice, lemon juice, and 1/2 tsp toasted sesame oil in a jar.
Shake vigorously 10 seconds until lightly emulsified.
Serve chilled over ice cubes.
tips: Sweet pear and toasted sesame oil bring delicate Korean flavors into a soothing, light tonic.
Great chilled after a walk or light meal.

recipes.title: Crisp Pineapple, Apple & Sesame Oil Citrus Press
recipes.summary: Sweet golden pineapple and apple juice brightened with lime and spearmint, rounded softly with a half-teaspoon of toasted sesame oil.
steps: Shake pineapple juice, apple juice, lime juice, and 1/2 tsp toasted sesame oil briskly in a lidded jar for 10 seconds.
Pour over ice into a chilled glass.
Garnish with lightly bruised spearmint leaves and serve immediately.
tips: Just half a teaspoon of toasted sesame oil gives bright orchard-tropical juice a subtle roasted elegance.
Shake gently before the final sip if needed.

recipes.title: Toasted Sesame Oil, Pearl Barley, Ginger & Celery Morning Congee
recipes.summary: Soothing Asian-style breakfast congee simmering quick pearl barley with finely diced celery stalk, grated ginger, cilantro, and fragrant toasted sesame oil.
steps: Simmer quick barley, finely diced celery stalk, grated ginger, black pepper, and broth 12 to 13 minutes until velvety.
Ladle the steaming savory porridge into warm bowls.
Drizzle generously with toasted sesame oil and scatter fresh cilantro.
tips: Drizzling toasted sesame oil right before eating fills the room with warm nutty aroma.
Soft and restorative.

recipes.title: Soft Scrambled Eggs with Toasted Sesame Oil, Salmon & Shiso
recipes.summary: Cloud-soft morning eggs gently folded with flaked cooked salmon, grated ginger, fresh shiso ribbons, black pepper, and aromatic toasted sesame oil.
steps: Warm rice bran oil and grated ginger gently 20 seconds, then pour in whisked eggs and black pepper, stirring slowly into soft curds.
Fold in flaked cooked salmon off the heat.
Plate warm, drizzle with toasted sesame oil, and garnish with ribboned shiso.
tips: Use mild oil for cooking and finish with aromatic toasted sesame oil off the heat.
High-protein omega-3 breakfast.

recipes.title: Toasted Sesame Oil, Banana, Dark Chocolate & Cinnamon Halva Oats
recipes.summary: Inspired by sweet sesame halva—creamy rolled oats simmered with mashed banana and cinnamon, topped with melted 70% dark chocolate and toasted sesame oil.
steps: Simmer rolled oats, milk, mashed banana, and ground cinnamon 6 to 7 minutes until silky.
Stir in chopped dark chocolate off the heat until glossy.
Spoon into bowls and finish with a warm nutty drizzle of toasted sesame oil.
tips: Sesame and dark chocolate are a beloved Middle Eastern dessert pairing.
A little toasted sesame oil goes a long way.

recipes.title: Toasted Sesame Oil, Sweet Orange, Blueberry & Ginger Yogurt
recipes.summary: Creamy Greek yogurt accented with sweet orange segments, fresh blueberries, a whisper of grated ginger, and a delicate drizzle of toasted sesame oil.
steps: Swirl orange zest and grated ginger softly into Greek yogurt and divide between two bowls.
Arrange orange segments and fresh blueberries over top.
Finish with a delicate thread of toasted sesame oil.
tips: Citrus and sweet berries turn toasted sesame oil into a fragrant morning drizzle.
Zero cooking required.

recipes.title: Savory Morning Chicken, Turmeric, Celery & Sesame Oil Rice
recipes.summary: Warm comforting morning rice topped with tender poached chicken, softened celery stalk, golden turmeric, black pepper, cilantro, and toasted sesame oil.
steps: Warm finely diced celery stalk, turmeric, black pepper, and shredded chicken in 3 tbsp broth 4 minutes until tender.
Spoon over warm soft cooked rice.
Drizzle generously with toasted sesame oil and scatter fresh cilantro.
tips: Gentle savory breakfast inspired by classic Asian morning rice bowls.
Soft, fragrant, and energizing.

recipes.title: Chilled Sesame Oil Soba with Poached Chicken, Celery & Shiso
recipes.summary: Silky cooled soba noodles dressed in toasted sesame oil, fresh orange juice, and grated ginger, tossed with poached chicken, shaved celery, and shiso.
steps: Cook soba noodles until very tender, rinse cool, and drain well.
Whisk toasted sesame oil, fresh orange juice, grated ginger, and 1 tbsp water.
Toss noodles with dressing, shredded poached chicken, shaved celery stalk, and ribboned shiso.
tips: Velvety chilled noodles require little effort and pack fragrant sesame-ginger synergy.
Light and refreshing.

recipes.title: Toasted Sesame Oil Salmon, Sweet Orange, Cilantro & Barley Bowl
recipes.summary: No-cook omega-3 lunch layering flaky poached salmon, cooled pearl barley, sweet orange segments, grated ginger, cilantro, and toasted sesame oil.
steps: Whisk toasted sesame oil, fresh orange juice, and grated ginger.
Divide tender pearl barley between two bowls and arrange salmon and orange segments over top.
Drizzle with sesame-orange dressing and scatter fresh cilantro.
tips: Toasted sesame oil lifts flaky salmon and nutty barley effortlessly.
Ready in minutes.

recipes.title: Chilled Silken Tofu with Toasted Sesame Oil, Ginger & Sichuan Pepper
recipes.summary: Classic soothing chilled silken tofu spooned with toasted sesame oil, grated ginger, a delicate floral pinch of Sichuan pepper, celery, and cilantro.
steps: Scoop chilled silken tofu gently into two bowls.
Stir toasted sesame oil, grated ginger, finely ground Sichuan pepper, and 1 tbsp warm water.
Spoon over the tofu and top with very finely minced celery and chopped cilantro.
tips: Use just a tiny pinch of finely ground Sichuan pepper for aromatic citrus perfume without heat.
Ultra-soft spoonable lunch.

recipes.title: Sesame Oil, Cantaloupe, Red Grape & Spearmint Chickpea Salad
recipes.summary: Lively fusion midday salad pairing soft chickpeas, sweet cantaloupe, halved red grapes, torn spearmint, grated ginger, and toasted sesame oil.
steps: Whisk toasted sesame oil, fresh orange juice, and grated fresh ginger.
Fold in soft chickpeas, ripe cantaloupe, halved red grapes, and torn spearmint.
Toss gently and serve cool.
tips: Toasted sesame oil with sweet melon and mint tastes crisp and unexpectedly refreshing.
Zero cooking needed.

recipes.title: Warm Black Tea Ochazuke with Chicken, Shiso & Toasted Sesame Oil
recipes.summary: Comforting hot tea-over-rice bowl combining soft rice, shredded poached chicken, grated ginger, ribboned shiso, mild black tea, and toasted sesame oil.

ingredient_details.item: freshly brewed hot mild black tea

steps: Divide warm soft rice between two deep bowls and top with shredded poached chicken and grated ginger.
Pour hot freshly brewed mild black tea gently over the bowls.
Finish with toasted sesame oil and ribboned fresh shiso.
tips: Steeping soft rice in aromatic tea with sesame oil is gentle, hydrating, and effortless to eat.
Use decaf tea if preferred.

recipes.title: Ginger-Steamed Salmon with Toasted Sesame Oil, Celery & Shiso
recipes.summary: Delicate skillet-steamed salmon topped with thinly sliced celery stalk, grated ginger, orange zest, ribboned shiso, and fragrant toasted sesame oil.
steps: Lay thinly sliced celery stalk in a skillet with 1/3 cup water and nestle salmon fillets topped with grated ginger on top.
Cover tightly and gently steam 10 to 11 minutes until salmon is flaky and celery is tender.
Transfer to warm plates, scatter orange zest and ribboned shiso, and drizzle with toasted sesame oil.
tips: Steaming keeps salmon moist without a single drop of heavy frying oil.
Toasted sesame oil perfumes the dish right at serving.

recipes.title: Warm Sesame Oil Chicken, Celery, Sichuan Pepper & Pearl Barley
recipes.summary: Tender braised chicken and celery stalk seasoned with grated ginger, a floral whisper of Sichuan pepper, and cilantro over pearl barley with toasted sesame oil.
steps: Warm rice bran oil with grated ginger and finely ground Sichuan pepper 30 seconds, then add thinly sliced celery and diced chicken.
Add broth, cover, and simmer gently 10 minutes until tender.
Spoon over warm pearl barley, drizzle with toasted sesame oil, and top with cilantro.
tips: Cook in neutral rice bran oil and finish with fragrant toasted sesame oil at the end.
Soft, savory, and balanced.

recipes.title: Poached Cod in Ginger-Orange Broth with Fennel Seed & Sesame Oil
recipes.summary: Silky coastal-Asian fusion broth poaching flaky cod with grated ginger, fresh orange juice, crushed fennel seed, cilantro, and toasted sesame oil.
steps: Simmer vegetable broth, fresh orange juice, grated ginger, and crushed fennel seed 4 minutes.
Nestle cod fillets into the fragrant broth, cover, and gently poach 7 to 8 minutes until flaky.
Ladle fish and warm broth into shallow bowls and finish with toasted sesame oil and cilantro.
tips: Brothy poached cod glides down effortlessly and warms you from the inside.
Fennel seed echoes subtle star-anise notes.

recipes.title: Glazed Soft Tofu & Sweet Potato with Turmeric, Nigella & Sesame Oil
recipes.summary: Velvety pan-steamed sweet potato and soft tofu warmed with golden turmeric, cumin, black pepper, toasted nigella seed, and fragrant toasted sesame oil.
steps: Simmer small-diced sweet potato with turmeric, cumin, black pepper, and 1/2 cup water, covered, 11 minutes until fork-tender.
Gently fold in cubed tofu for 3 minutes until heated through.
Remove from heat, drizzle with toasted sesame oil, and scatter cilantro and nigella seeds.
tips: Soft sweet potato and tofu absorb aromatic toasted sesame oil effortlessly.
Plant-forward comfort.

recipes.title: Gentle Glazed Turkey, Dark Cherry, Anise Seed & Sesame Oil Bowl
recipes.summary: Savory-sweet weeknight turkey skillet gently simmered with halved dark cherries, grated ginger, crushed anise seed, celery stalk, and toasted sesame oil.
steps: Cook finely crumbled lean ground turkey and finely diced celery stalk in 1 tsp toasted sesame oil with grated ginger and anise seed 5 minutes.
Add broth and halved dark cherries, simmering gently 7 minutes until glossy.
Spoon over warm soft rice and finish with remaining toasted sesame oil.
tips: Anise seed and sweet dark cherries create a gentle five-spice style glaze without harsh heat.
Soft and easy to eat.

recipes.title: Halva-Style Toasted Sesame Oil, Banana, Cacao & Cinnamon Smoothie
recipes.summary: Creamy nutty smoothie inspired by chocolate sesame halva—blending frozen banana, finely chopped 70% dark chocolate, cinnamon, oat milk, and toasted sesame oil.
steps: Blend oat milk, frozen banana, chopped dark chocolate, and ground cinnamon 45 seconds until silky.
Add 1 tsp toasted sesame oil and pulse 3 seconds.
Pour cold and enjoy immediately.
tips: Just 1 tsp toasted sesame oil creates luscious toasted-tahini flavor with zero chalkiness.
Naturally sweet and dairy-free.

recipes.title: Toasted Sesame Oil, Dark Cherry, Ginger & Soft Barley Smoothie
recipes.summary: Velvety stone-fruit grain shake uniting frozen dark cherries, chilled soft cooked barley, grated fresh ginger, milk, and a delicate spoon of toasted sesame oil.
steps: Blend milk, frozen dark cherries, chilled soft cooked barley, and grated fresh ginger 50 seconds until smooth.
Add toasted sesame oil and pulse 3 seconds.
Serve cold right away.
tips: Nutty barley and toasted sesame oil harmonize beautifully with sweet cherries.
Gentle soluble fiber.

recipes.title: Bright Toasted Sesame Oil, Orange, Cantaloupe & Shiso Smoothie
recipes.summary: Refreshing Japanese-inspired citrus-melon smoothie pairing peeled orange, sweet cantaloupe, fresh shiso leaves, yogurt, and a hint of toasted sesame oil.
steps: Blend peeled sweet orange, chilled cantaloupe, Greek yogurt, and fresh shiso leaves until velvety.
Add toasted sesame oil and pulse 2 seconds.
Pour cold and enjoy immediately.
tips: Bright orange and aromatic shiso keep toasted sesame oil light and lively.
Smooth and cooling.

recipes.title: Chilled Black Tea, Blueberry, Clove & Sesame Oil Chai Smoothie
recipes.summary: Aromatic violet tea smoothie blending chilled mild black tea, wild blueberries, frozen banana, a pinch of clove, oat milk, and toasted sesame oil.
steps: Blend chilled mild black tea, oat milk, frozen blueberries, frozen banana, and a tiny pinch of clove until smooth.
Add toasted sesame oil and pulse 3 seconds.
Serve chilled right away.
tips: Toasted sesame adds warm roasted depth to blueberry tea smoothies.
Decaf black tea works cleanly.

recipes.title: Roasted Sesame Oil, Iced Coffee, Golden Turmeric & Banana Shake
recipes.summary: Warm cafe-style shake blending chilled coffee, frozen banana, golden turmeric, a tiny pinch of black pepper, oat milk, and a teaspoon of toasted sesame oil.
steps: Blend chilled coffee, oat milk, frozen banana, golden turmeric, and a tiny pinch of black pepper until smooth.
Add toasted sesame oil and pulse 3 seconds.
Pour cold and enjoy right away.
tips: Inspired by Korean sesame-cream lattes—nutty, smooth, and deeply aromatic.
Use decaf coffee if preferred.

recipes.title: Aromatic Sesame Oil, Fresh Orange, Ginger & Shiso Pressed Tonic
recipes.summary: Crisp Japanese-citrus press combining strained fresh orange juice, grated ginger, and fresh shiso whisked gently with a few drops of toasted sesame oil.
steps: Blend fresh orange juice, grated ginger, and fresh shiso leaves 25 seconds.
Strain cleanly through a fine-mesh sieve into a chilled pitcher.
Whisk in toasted sesame oil briskly and pour into glasses immediately.
tips: Just a delicate whisper of toasted sesame oil adds unforgettable perfume to ginger-orange juice.
Silky and bright.

recipes.title: Chilled Sesame Oil, Cantaloupe, Celery Stalk & Spearmint Press
recipes.summary: Cooling melon-garden press combining sweet cantaloupe, crisp celery stalk, and spearmint with a tiny whisk of fragrant toasted sesame oil.
steps: Blend cantaloupe, chopped celery stalk, spearmint leaves, and cold water 35 seconds.
Press cleanly through a fine-mesh strainer.
Whisk in toasted sesame oil briefly and serve chilled.
tips: Savory-sweet melon and celery pair gracefully with a few drops of toasted sesame oil.
Crisp and pulp-free.

recipes.title: Toasted Sesame Oil, Chilled Barley Water, Ginger & Cinnamon Press
recipes.summary: Roasted-grain inspired refresher uniting chilled strained barley water, grated ginger, cinnamon, orange juice, and a light whisk of toasted sesame oil.
steps: Stir chilled barley water, fresh orange juice, grated ginger, and cinnamon, then strain smoothly through a fine sieve.
Whisk in toasted sesame oil briskly for 10 seconds.
Pour cold and serve right away.
tips: Echoes beloved Japanese roasted barley tea (mugicha) with a silky toasted sesame accent.
Naturally soothing.

recipes.title: Ruby Sesame Oil, Red Grape, Black Tea & Golden Turmeric Cooler
recipes.summary: Bright pressed botanical tea blending red grapes, mild black tea, turmeric, and a pinch of black pepper with a whisper of toasted sesame oil.
steps: Blend red grapes, turmeric, a tiny pinch of black pepper, and 1/2 cup chilled black tea 30 seconds.
Strain cleanly through a fine-mesh sieve into remaining chilled black tea.
Whisk in toasted sesame oil briefly and serve cold.
tips: Sweet red grapes balance earthy turmeric and toasted sesame smoothly.
Use decaf black tea in the evening.

recipes.title: Ruby Sesame Oil, Dark Cherry, Raspberry & Lemon Balm Press
recipes.summary: Vibrant strained crimson juice blending dark cherries, raspberries, and calming lemon balm, finished with a delicate whisk of toasted sesame oil.
steps: Blend pitted cherries, raspberries, fresh lemon balm, and cold water 30 seconds.
Press thoroughly through a fine-mesh strainer to catch all raspberry seeds.
Whisk in toasted sesame oil briefly and pour chilled.
tips: A gentle drop of toasted sesame oil adds silky floral richness to red berries.
Seedless and easy to sip.
